recordSet.description: Station metadata from Service public de Wallonie (SPW) — Hydrométrie (https://hydrometrie.wallonie.be/mentions-legales.html; DataSPW-CGU.pdf v1.1). This metadata projection is excluded from RivRetrieve's MIT software licence. Source names, water-body names, and catchment areas remain unchanged; third-party redistribution or commercial diffusion requires SPW authorization. Attribution: Sources des données : Service public de Wallonie.
